cohort: The study included 150 pregnancies with twin gestations, irrespective of gestational age and parity, admitted to the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology or casualty during July 2024 to June 2025.
finding: The most common maternal complication was preterm labor, followed by anemia, and most neonates had a low APGR score at 1st minute, with reported intrauterine and neonatal deaths.
